chunks.title: World_famous_Hyderabadi_Mutton_Fry
chunks.text: Hello everyone, Assalamualaikum, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Asmaa. Today I am going to show you how to make Hyderabadi Mutton Fry. If you like my recipe then please like and subscribe to my channel. I have taken boneless mutton and washed it. I have cut it into small pieces. Now we will cook it in a pan. We will not cook it in a cooker because it will taste the same. We will put it in a pan. Now we will add salt. We have kept it on flame. We will add half spoon turmeric powder. And one spoon of ginger paste. I have also added green chilies. We will add that. And we will add little oil. It will fry later. And we will mix all of this well. We will not add water now. Water will separate from it. We will cook it on high flame until all the water separates. We will cover it and let it cook for 2-3 minutes. After 3 minutes we will remove the lid. See how much water has separated. Now we will dry it. We will remove the lid. Now the water has dried. Now we will add more water. It is still not cooked. So that it becomes tender. We will add more water. And we will cook it on medium flame for 10-15 minutes. After 10-15 minutes we will remove the lid. I have checked in between. It is not that it is stuck. Now we will fry it. We will fry it on the pan. We are frying it on the pan. Now we will add the mutton in the hot oil. We will add the mutton now and the spices later. Otherwise the spices will get burnt. And we will fry it again in the oil. We will fry it again. We will let it fry well. Now we will add the curry leaves. Now we will add the coriander leaves. We will add the green chilies. And we will add the red chili powder. We are adding the red chili powder so that it does not have too much color. You can add it according to your taste. I always tell you to add the red chili powder according to your taste. And we will add half a teaspoon of garam masala. This is my homemade garam masala. And we will add half a teaspoon of black pepper powder. And we will mix it well. Now we have turned off the flame. We will not cook it for long otherwise the chili will get burnt. We will serve it now. Now my fried mutton is ready. We will squeeze some lemon juice in it. If you like my recipe then like it and subscribe to my channel. Thanks for watching.
